purpose: Raise the KVM minimum timer period. Reduces kvm-pit kernel-thread CPU overhead on x86. Caveat: same setting also affects APIC timer events — workload-test before deploying.

flags.name: min_timer_period_us
flags.doc: Minimum interval between guest-injected timer interrupts.

examples.invocation: sudo modprobe -r kvm_intel kvm; sudo modprobe kvm min_timer_period_us=1000; sudo modprobe kvm_intel; echo 'options kvm min_timer_period_us=1000' | sudo tee /etc/modprobe.d/kvm.conf
examples.expected_output: kvm reloaded with min 1000μs timer period; persistent across boots

purpose: Disable Kernel Samepage Merging — required for multi-tenant Firecracker hosts to mitigate page-deduplication side channels.
Disable all swap to prevent guest memory contents from being written to disk (data remanence). Make persistent by removing swap entries from /etc/fstab.

flags.name: -a
flags.doc: All swap devices listed in /etc/fstab and /proc/swaps.

examples.invocation: sudo swapoff -a; grep -q /dev /proc/swaps && echo 'STILL HAS SWAP' || echo 'OK'

purpose: Audit host's protections against speculation side channels (Spectre, Meltdown, MDS, etc.). Run as part of deployment validation; rerun after any kernel/microcode update.

examples.expected_output: Per-CVE NOT VULNERABLE / VULNERABLE / MITIGATION KO summary

purpose: Format a sparse host file as ext4 to use as a Firecracker rootfs (PUT /drives is_root_device=true).

examples.invocation: dd if=/dev/zero of=rootfs.ext4 bs=1M count=2048 status=none; mkfs.ext4 -L rootfs rootfs.ext4
